label: PF Backlog 94
title: Backend: expose telemetry via Prometheus /metrics (keep JSON telemetry too)
body:
Owner wants telemetry exposed. We already have JSON telemetry (core/pipeline_telemetry.py) but NO /metrics endpoint. Add GET /metrics in Prometheus text exposition format (from pipeline_telemetry + quality-metrics + run/agent counters), alongside the existing JSON /api/v1/telemetry. Wire into dashboard/api/app.py. Do NOT remove JSON telemetry - expose BOTH.

ADDITIONAL FIELDS (folded from BI-0108 - genuinely new; see merge note):
- prefix_cache_hit_rate: provider prompt-cache hit % (share of prompt tokens served from the provider's prompt cache) per agent/stage.
- assembly_ms: context assembly time in milliseconds (time to build the prompt/context package) per agent/stage.
_note: done: GET /metrics Prometheus text (pipeline_telemetry per project)

dashboard_impact.reason: Per-agent context/cost telemetry (prompt tokens, prefix_cache_hit_rate, assembly_ms, retries) must be visible in the dashboard telemetry/metrics view.
